description: This file defines the SiloConnectionListener class, which manages network connections for silo-to-silo communication in Orleans runtime. It creates and configures connections, manages the lifecycle of the listener, and handles inbound connection settings.

classes.name: SiloConnectionListener
classes.description: A network connection listener for silo communication, implementing connection management and lifecycle participation.

methods.name: SiloConnectionListener
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the listener with required services and configurations.

methods.name: Endpoint
methods.description: Property that returns the listening endpoint for silos.

methods.name: CreateConnection
methods.description: Creates a new SiloConnection object for incoming connection contexts.

methods.name: ConfigureConnectionBuilder
methods.description: Configures the inbound connection builder with silo-specific options.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes to the silo lifecycle for startup and shutdown events.

methods.name: OnStart
methods.description: Handles actions when the lifecycle signals start, including binding and accepting connections.

methods.name: OnStop
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the lifecycle signals stop.
